description: This file defines a form processor class 'AdminImpactDataForm' within the Goteo administrative library. It provides functionality for creating, validating, and saving impact data forms in the admin interface, including handling form fields, validation constraints, file uploads, and interaction with the ImpactData model.

classes.name: AdminImpactDataForm
classes.description: A form processor class for handling admin impact data form creation, validation, and saving, including file uploads and interaction with ImpactData model.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the impact data form with various fields such as title, description, data, image, type, source, result message, operation type, and submit button.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data, handling image uploads and removing images if necessary, then updates the ImpactData model.

methods.name: getImpactDataTypes
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares an array of impact data types for form choices.

methods.name: getImpactSources
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares an array of impact data sources for form choices.

methods.name: getImpactOperations
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares an array of impact data operations for form choices.
